items.situation: friend sharing news or personal update
items.speaker: I finally passed my driving test yesterday.

options.A: Actually, I knew you'd nail it.
options.B: The test was really hard for me.
options.C: I'm heading to the store later.
options.D: You should renew your license soon.

items.explanation: 正确答案 A：以话语标记「Actually」开头，随后间接地表达对好消息的祝贺与信任，是自然的口语回应（marker_led_indirect）。B 抓住「test」这个词，只谈自己考试很难，属语义联想陷阱，并未回应对方的好消息。C 完全跑题，谈自己去商店，与考驾照无关。D 误解语境，考完驾照并不需要「续期驾照」，逻辑颠倒。

items.situation: student checking lost-and-found at front desk
items.speaker: When does the lost-and-found usually get cleared out?

options.A: I lost my phone here last week too.
options.B: Actually, you'd better claim it before Friday.
options.C: The cafeteria closes at nine tonight.
options.D: It's the desk right by the entrance.

items.explanation: 正确答案 B：以「Actually」开头，间接提醒对方在周五前认领，等于回答了「什么时候会被清空」这一时间关切（marker_led_indirect）。A 抓住「lost」谈自己也丢过手机，属语义联想陷阱，未回答时间。C 完全跑题，谈食堂关门时间。D 回答的是「在哪里」而非「什么时候」，答非所问。

items.situation: student asking a librarian about a book or resource
items.speaker: Do you have the second edition of this textbook?

options.A: The book club meets every Tuesday.
options.B: It costs about forty dollars new.
options.C: Yes, it's on the reserve shelf.

items.explanation: 正确答案 C：直接肯定回答「有」，并告知在预留架上，是对是非问句的直接事实回应（direct_topical）。A 抓住「book」谈读书会，属语义联想陷阱。B 回答的是「多少钱」而非「有没有」，答错问题类型。D 完全跑题，谈自己要还书。

items.situation: acknowledging someone's unavailability or schedule conflict
items.speaker: Can you make it to the study session tonight?

options.A: The session covered chapter five today.
options.B: No, I've never been there before.
options.C: My laptop charger stopped working again.
options.D: I'm afraid I've got my hands full.

items.explanation: 正确答案 D：用习语「got my hands full」（忙得不可开交）委婉表示来不了，是地道的间接拒绝（idiomatic）。A 抓住「session」描述课程内容，属语义联想陷阱，未回应邀约。B 误解成「你去过那里吗」，答非所问。C 完全跑题，谈充电器坏了。

items.situation: student asking about gym or sports facility hours
items.speaker: I'm not sure when the gym closes tonight.

options.A: Why not just check the app for hours?
options.B: The gym added new treadmills last month.
options.C: I finished my essay this morning.
options.D: No, I don't really like working out.

items.explanation: 正确答案 A：用反问「不如查一下 app」来推进对话、解决对方不确定关门时间的问题（counter_question）。B 抓住「gym」谈新添跑步机，属语义联想陷阱。C 完全跑题，谈自己写完论文。D 误解语境，答成个人是否喜欢健身，答非所问。

items.situation: asking a store clerk about a return or exchange
items.speaker: What's the deadline for returning these shoes?

options.A: Those shoes come in three colors.
options.B: Just keep the receipt and you're fine.
options.C: They're over on the second floor.
options.D: I paid with my credit card earlier.

items.explanation: 正确答案 B：不直接报出截止日期，而是点出「留着收据就没问题」，解决了对方退货的真实顾虑（context_shift）。A 抓住「shoes」谈鞋子有几种颜色，属语义联想陷阱。C 回答的是「在哪里」而非「截止日期」，答错问题类型。D 完全跑题，谈自己用信用卡付款。

items.situation: coordinating airport pickup with a friend
items.speaker: How will you get to the airport on time?

options.A: The airport parking is really expensive.
options.B: At around six in the morning.
options.C: Don't worry, I've got it covered.
options.D: I still need to pack my suitcase.

items.explanation: 正确答案 C：用习语「got it covered」（都安排好了）打消对方担心，是地道的口语回应（idiomatic）。A 抓住「airport」谈停车费贵，属语义联想陷阱。B 回答的是「什么时候」而非「怎么去」，答错问题类型。D 虽与出行沾边但只谈自己还没收拾行李，未回答如何准时到，属跑题。

items.situation: asking for directions to a nearby location
items.speaker: Do you know how to get to the station from here?

options.A: The station was really crowded yesterday.
options.B: No, I don't take the train much.
options.C: My phone battery just died on me.
options.D: Sure, it's just a stone's throw away.

items.explanation: 正确答案 D：用习语「a stone's throw away」（近在咫尺）肯定地告知很近，推进对话（idiomatic）。A 抓住「station」谈车站昨天很挤，属语义联想陷阱。B 误解成「你坐不坐火车」，答非所问。C 完全跑题，谈自己手机没电了。

items.situation: offering help to someone who seems stressed
items.speaker: Why do you look so worn out today?

options.A: Well, I barely slept a wink last night.
options.B: These old sneakers are totally worn out.
options.C: The meeting starts around noon today.
options.D: Let me carry those heavy bags for you.

items.explanation: 正确答案 A：以「Well」开头，作为被关心的一方间接解释自己疲惫的原因（几乎没睡），角色一致（marker_led_indirect）。B 利用「worn out」的多义，谈鞋子破旧，属语义/一词多义陷阱。C 完全跑题，谈会议时间。D 是提供帮助的一方（说话人一侧）才会说的话，角色颠倒（role_inversion），不能作为被问者的回答。

items.situation: student asking about printing or scanning at computer lab
items.speaker: Where can I scan my documents in the lab?

options.A: The documents were actually due last week.
options.B: The scanner's over by the far window.
options.C: It's free for all registered students.
options.D: My laptop keeps freezing up lately.

items.explanation: 正确答案 B：直接告知扫描仪的位置，是对「在哪里扫描」这一 WH 问句的直接事实回答（direct_topical）。A 抓住「documents」谈文件上周就该交，属语义联想陷阱。C 回答的是「要不要钱」而非「在哪里」，答错问题类型。D 完全跑题，谈自己笔记本老死机。
